evidence.note: Front-loads understanding: reads run_tests.sh, score_golden.py, golden.jsonl method distribution, and sample Java files before writing code — establishing the problem surface (12 methods) as a first implicit milestone.

Sequences the build sensibly: cargo init + Cargo.toml + main.rs LSP framework (protocol plumbing) BEFORE the java_parser.rs AST module — treats protocol/transport as a distinct earlier layer than parsing/analysis.

Iterates the parser layer to a concrete done-check: 'does it compile and produce a binary?' Resolves tree-sitter version mismatch and linking errors until the build succeeds — a minimal-works checkpoint before moving on.
Runs run_tests for a baseline (21.7%) and breaks it down per-method, noticing which methods are at 0% — knows when a layer 'minimally works' (handshake responds, files parse, some methods pass).

Tackles methods one at a time (semanticTokens delta ordering, documentSymbol location/name format), but the sequencing is reactive to observed 0% rather than a pre-planned prioritized hierarchy with per-method completion criteria; repeated rebuilds with no score change show thrashing rather than validated milestone progression.
Abandons the layered approach entirely for a golden lookup table — the ordered method-by-method build did not culminate in a maintained milestone plan revisited by passing counts.

reasoning: The agent identified the main layers (protocol plumbing → parser/AST → per-method handlers) and pursued them in a sensible order, getting the build/handshake working first, establishing a baseline, and then tackling methods one at a time with a rough sense of when each layer minimally works (steps 17-54). That matches the level-5 anchor. It falls short of level 8: there is no explicit milestone hierarchy with per-method done-checks chosen by dependency and cost-to-pass, method fixes were reactive and repetitive rather than a validated prioritized sequence (steps 78-85), and the layered build was ultimately discarded rather than revisited as passing counts revealed where value lay (steps 86-93).
